key_insight: GeoDiv KAN combines geometry-dependent feature gating with a divergence-free formulation to solve time-fractional incompressible Navier–Stokes equations on complex domains.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets geometry-aware flow prediction and CFD reconstruction, with applications to unsteady cylinder flow and turbulent RANS flow through a U-bend.
method: Uses a Gaussian radial basis function Kolmogorov–Arnold network.
Gates features according to domain geometry.
Enforces incompressibility by construction through a streamfunction formulation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports higher predictive accuracy than PINN, PIKAN, RBF KAN, and DF RBFKAN on square, circular, and star-shaped benchmarks, plus applications to public cylinder-flow and U-bend CFD datasets.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify accuracy gains or computational cost, leaving scalability and practical efficiency unclear.
paper_title: GeoDiv KAN Solver for Time Fractional Navier Stokes Equations on Complex Domains to Realistic CFD Reconstruction
